fields.name: 3_second_video_plays

fields.name: like

fields.name: omni_purchase

fields.name: page_engagement

fields.name: post_reaction

fields.name: post_save

fields.name: ad_creation_package_config
fields.description: Process of configuring a campaign to achieve specific advertising objectives.

enum_values.description: The Advantage+ sales campaign is an automated campaign setup that leverages machine learning and Meta's best practices to help advertisers increase online sales performance and drive efficiency. It combines various elements such as audience targeting, budget management, and ad placements to optimize ad delivery and performance.

fields.name: adset_id

fields.name: adset_name

fields.name: app_install

fields.name: attribution_setting

7-day click

From Apple's SKAdNetwork API
Incremental attribution

fields.name: bid_amount

fields.name: bid_strategy
fields.description: The way you want Meta to bid in the auction, based on your cost goals and your optimization for ad delivery. This will display as either lowest cost, cost cap, bid cap, target cost, highest value or minimum ROAS depending on your cost or ROAS control selection.

fields.name: billing_event

fields.name: budget_remaining

Buy in advance for more predictable outcomes.

fields.name: campaign_name

fields.name: clicks

fields.name: conversion_domain

fields.name: cost_per_link_click_result

You can use it to compare performance among different campaigns, ad sets, or ads, and identify areas of opportunity.

fields.name: cost_per_thruplay

fields.name: cost_per_video_view

fields.name: cpm
fields.description: The average cost of 1,000 impressions. CPM is a common metric used by the online advertising industry to gauge the cost-effectiveness of an ad entity.

fields.name: cpp

fields.name: creative_id

fields.name: ctr

fields.name: delivery
fields.description: The current status of your campaign, ad set or ad delivery.

enum_values.description: The campaign, ad set or ad with a draft status is one that has been created but is not yet active or delivering ads.
The campaign, ad set or ad isn't running yet.
The campaign, ad set or ad is on and running, delivering as expected.
The campaign, ad set or ad isn't running.
The campaign, ad set or ad can't run at all because there's a problem that needs attention.
The deleted delivery status for a campaign means that the campaign has been permanently removed from your ad account.
The completed status indicates that the campaign, ad set or ad has reached its scheduled end date or has fulfilled its budget and objectives.
This status means the campaign, ad set or ad has been manually paused or turned off by the advertiser.

fields.name: delivery_sub_status
fields.description: Delivery sub status in Meta Ads Manager appears beneath the main delivery status at the ad set level, indicating detailed states such as 'Active (Learning)' or 'Active (Learning Limited)'. This helps advertisers understand if an ad set is delivering but still optimizing, or if it's struggling to exit the learning phase.

enum_values.description: During the learning phase, the delivery system is exploring the best way to deliver your ad set when you either create a new ad or ad set or make a significant edit to an existing one.
If your ad set isn't getting enough results to exit the learning phase, the Delivery column status reads 'Learning limited'.

fields.name: destination_type
fields.description: The destination type selected for the ad set.

fields.name: effective_status
fields.description: The actual delivery status, which can differ from `status` because it accounts for parent state, ad review, billing, and budget conditions.

enum_values.description: The entity is delivering.
The entity is paused by the advertiser.
The entity is deleted.
The entity is archived.
The entity is in process (e.g. scheduled).
The entity has issues blocking full delivery.
The parent campaign is paused.
The parent ad set is paused.
An individual ad under this entity is paused.
The ad was disapproved during review.
The ad is waiting on review.
The ad is pre-approved.
Delivery is paused pending valid billing info.

fields.name: lifetime_budget

fields.description: The total return on ad spend (ROAS) from mobile app purchases. This is based on the value that you assigned when you set up the app event.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of an account, campaign, adset, or ad. Do NOT use the name filter to retrieve metrics, metric breakdowns, or attributes for an ad entity. In those cases, always use the ID filter instead.

fields.name: objective
fields.description: The objective reflecting the goal you want to achieve with your advertising.

enum_values.description: Show your ads to people who are most likely to remember them.
Find new people to install your app and continue using it.
This objective is designed to increase awareness of a brand, product, or service. However, it's more focused on building brand familiarity and affinity rather than just reaching a large audience.

This objective is ideal for e-commerce businesses that want to drive sales of specific products from their catalog. Advertisers can use this objective to showcase their products and encourage users to make purchases.

This objective is designed to drive specific actions on a website or app, such as filling out a form, making a purchase, or subscribing to a service. Advertisers can use this objective to optimize their campaigns for conversions and maximize ROI.

This objective is focused on engaging users who have already installed a canvas app (a type of Facebook app). Advertisers can use this objective to encourage users to re-engage with their app and increase overall engagement.
This objective is designed to drive installs of canvas apps. Advertisers can use this objective to promote their canvas apps and encourage users to install them.
Get more messages, purchases through messaging, video views, post engagement, Page likes, event responses or community engagement.
This objective is focused on driving responses to events, such as ticket sales or RSVPs. Advertisers can use this objective to promote their events and encourage users to respond.
This objective is designed to engage users who have already installed a mobile app. Advertisers can use this objective to encourage users to re-engage with their app and increase overall engagement.
This objective is focused on generating leads for a business. Advertisers can use this objective to collect contact information from users who are interested in their products or services.
Collect leads for your business or brand.
This objective is designed to encourage users to send messages to a business. Advertisers can use this objective to drive conversations with potential customers and increase engagement.
This objective is specifically focused on driving installs of mobile apps
This objective is designed to drive claims for offers, such as discounts or promotions. Advertisers can use this objective to encourage users to claim offers and increase sales.
This objective is focused on increasing the number of likes on a Facebook Page. Advertisers can use this objective to build their audience and increase engagement.

This objective is designed to increase engagement with a specific post on a Facebook Page. Advertisers can use this objective to drive likes, comments, shares, and other forms of engagement on a particular post.

This objective is focused on showing ads to as many people as possible within a target audience. Advertisers can use this objective to increase brand awareness and reach a large audience, but it's not ideal for driving conversions or sales.
Find people likely to purchase your product or service.
This objective is designed to drive foot traffic to physical stores. Advertisers can use this objective to promote their stores and encourage users to visit them in person.
Send people to a destination, like your website, app, Instagram profile or Facebook event.
This objective is designed to increase views of video content. Advertisers can use this objective to promote their videos and increase engagement with their audience.

fields.name: video_p95_watched_actions
